sites.name: Fortescue Hive (headquarters)
sites.description: Our new headquarters at 256 St Georges Terrace; the Hive is a purpose-built integrated operations centre that powers our Pilbara operations from Perth

source.label: FY25 Appendix 4E and Annual Report (ASX), operations overview
source.quote: relocated in December 2024 to our new headquarters at 256 St Georges Terrace, the Fortescue Hive is a purpose-built, integrated operations centre that powers our Pilbara operations from Perth.

sites.name: Cloudbreak mine (Chichester Hub)
sites.description: Founded in 2007; part of the Chichester Hub with Christmas Creek; produces over 40 million tonnes of iron ore per year (capacity 38-41 Mtpa)

source.label: FY26 Appendix 4E and Annual Report (ASX, Aug 20, 2026), operations overview
source.quote: Founded in 2007, Cloudbreak forms part of our Chichester Hub - alongside our Christmas Creek site - and produces over 40 million tonnes of iron ore per year.

sites.name: Christmas Creek mine (Chichester Hub)
sites.description: Produces over 50 million tonnes of iron ore per year; home to Fortescue's Green Energy Hub

source.label: FY26 Appendix 4E and Annual Report (ASX, Aug 20, 2026), operations overview
source.quote: Christmas Creek produces over 50 million tonnes of iron ore per year and is home to Fortescue's Green Energy Hub which pilots several green energy projects designed to support decarbonisation of operations.

sites.name: Solomon mine (Western Hub)
sites.description: Produces over 68 million tonnes of iron ore per year; two ore processing facilities, Kings and Firetail

source.label: FY26 Appendix 4E and Annual Report (ASX, Aug 20, 2026), operations overview
source.quote: Our Solomon site produces over 68 million tonnes of iron ore per year. The operation comprises two ore processing facilities, Kings and Firetail.

sites.name: Eliwana mine (Western Hub)
sites.description: First ore in late 2020; produces over 30 million tonnes of iron ore per year, railed 428 km to Herb Elliott Port

source.label: FY26 Appendix 4E and Annual Report (ASX, Aug 20, 2026), operations overview
source.quote: Eliwana produced its first ore in late 2020 and produces over 30 million tonnes of iron ore per year.

sites.name: Iron Bridge
sites.description: Magnetite operation; high-grade wet concentrate piped 135 km to Port Hedland; unincorporated joint venture (Fortescue 69%, Formosa Steel 31%)

source.label: FY26 Appendix 4E and Annual Report (ASX, Aug 20, 2026), operations overview
source.quote: Our Iron Bridge facility produces a high-grade wet concentrate product which is transported to Port Hedland through a 135-kilometre-long specialist slurry pipeline.

sites.name: Herb Elliott Port
sites.description: Capacity over 200 Mtpa; 1,000 carriers loaded and shipped in FY26

source.label: FY26 Appendix 4E and Annual Report (ASX, Aug 20, 2026), operations overview
source.quote: Location: Port Hedland, Western Australia (WA), Australia Ownership: 100% Capacity: >200 million tonnes per annum (Mtpa) … We operate the Herb Elliott Port Facility and Judith Street Harbour towage infrastructure. During FY26, we loaded and shipped 1000 carriers from Herb Elliott Port to send to our customers globally.

sites.name: Belinga Iron Ore Project
sites.description: One of the world's largest undeveloped high-grade hematite deposits; operated by Ivindo Iron SA, 72% owned by Fortescue

source.label: FY26 Appendix 4E and Annual Report (ASX, Aug 20, 2026), Fortescue Energy and projects
source.quote: The Belinga Project in north-east Gabon is one of the world's largest undeveloped high grade hematite deposits and represents a significant long-term growth opportunity for Fortescue.

notes: Country rows come from Fortescue's FY2025 Country-by-Country Report (GRI 207-4, company-hosted; FY ended Jun 30, 2025): employees and corporate income tax paid in cash by tax jurisdiction. No newer edition found (checked 2026-11-24): the FY26 sustainability site's report library still lists the FY2025 CbC report, and the FY26 Sustainability Report refers only to 'our latest available public Country-by-Country Report'. Only jurisdictions with employees or cash tax paid are listed; dashes (nil) are omitted, not recorded as 0. 6 employees working where Fortescue has no local entity ('Other countries') are not in the rows. The large U.K. headcount (1,182) is Fortescue's U.K. operations, which the report shows with losses. Cash tax excludes Western Australian state royalties; no royalty breakdown by jurisdiction was recorded. No state or regional data. Sites are re-read from the FY26 annual report (lodged with the ASX with the Appendix 4E on Aug 20, 2026): the Pilbara (Western Australia) mines, Iron Bridge, Herb Elliott Port and the Belinga project in Gabon; the mines connect to Port Hedland via 760km of rail. The FY26 report does not restate the headquarters address, so the Perth HQ (the Fortescue Hive at 256 St Georges Terrace) is still cited from the FY25 annual report.
